infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: Momo Scanner uses the camera to scan the QR code printed on your oversize/overweight load permit.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Momo Scanner uses your location to guide you turn-by-turn along the exact route on your permit and to warn you if you drift off the permitted route.
